before.app/billing/checkout.py:
import stripe


def create_charge(order):
    charge = stripe.Charge.create(
        amount_cents=order.total_cents,
        currency="usd",
        source=order.card_token,
    )
    return charge["id"]

after.app/billing/checkout.py:
import stripe


def create_charge(order):
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        pricing={"unit_amount": order.total_cents},
        currency="usd",
        payment_method=order.card_token,
        confirm=True,
    )
    return charge["id"]
